seal.statement: The release of a partition that has no write origin is authorized for a fresh founding CREATE by a committed fact that whichever leader answers reads and validates. NOT_LEADER is answered first, before any authority read, so a non-leader never grants or refuses on authority. The leader reads the founding create operation row in replica_operations authoritatively through its create-admission owner (the request carries the create identity as a lookup key only, never as authority) and grants only when the row matches the request's create identity, is an ADD of the leader's partition, has its create admission MATERIALIZED or ACTIVE and is not completed, and its first step carries a GENESIS founding stamp naming the leader's replica. Membership of the leader's committed configuration is not a grant condition, so a fresh group whose configuration changed before its release (an admitted learner, a replaced founder) still releases. The FRESH_CREATE in-memory token, its AUTHORIZATION WeakMap entry, the up-front authorizeFreshCreate read and the pending-token confirmation added by fresh-create-failure-after-committed-admission are deleted as superseded (R09, recorded in both quest logs). Refusals stay typed: an unavailable authority read is UNAVAILABLE{create_admission_authority, retryAfterMs} retried by the existing completion loop under the existing create deadline; a row that fails the conditions, a forged or foreign identity, a restored legacy group or a join ADD is OPERATOR_REQUIRED{fresh_storage_or_operator_authority, reason}; FRESH_SEED and OPERATOR authority are unchanged. On a fresh founding group whose first leader is on another node than a founder, that founder's release reaches CUT_OVER.
